messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: Im planning a gentle rollout of the feature flag fast-prefix-cache tonight. Goal: reduce cold token cost without harming latency. Proposed staged plan: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over ~90-120 minutes with observation windows. Safe defaults to start: max_batch_tokens=512, prefix_cache_ttl=30s at 10%. Need two watchers and rollback ready. Who can observe telemetry and run rollback if needed? :eyes:

devon: I can watch from 00:25-01:30 PDT. Ill monitor p95/p99 latency, error rate, and any coupling to embedding routes. I have the rollback script locally: `./ops/flags/rollback-fast-prefix.sh`.

sanjay: Ill wire the canary dashboard panels and set alert thresholds. Rollback command confirmed: `./ops/flags/disable-fast-prefix.sh prod` (tested in staging).

elise: Agree with starting conservative. Suggest this tweak: at 10% use prefix_cache_ttl=20s, at 40% move to 45s, then 100% -> 60s. That reduces early risk for long-lived requests.

maria: Updated plan then:
- 10% (prefix_cache_ttl=20s, max_batch_tokens=512)  observe 15m
- 40% (prefix_cache_ttl=45s)  observe 30m
- 100% (prefix_cache_ttl=60s)  finalize
Smoke gates: p99 < 280ms, error rate < 0.6% (5m rolling), token cost delta < 7%

tj: Ill pause my embeddings perf test rollouts until this finishes (dont want competing cache changes). Ill let product know about the slight delay.

devon: Running quick smoke now before flip: `./scripts/smoke_check.sh --flag fast-prefix-cache --window 5m --metrics p95,p99,errors,tokens_delta`

devon: smoke output snippet:
```
checks: latency_p95=110ms, latency_p99=200ms, errors=0.10%, tokens_delta=2.8%
status: pass
```

sanjay: Alerts set: pager if error rate >0.65% OR p99 > 320ms sustained 5m. Also added a dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/flags/fast-prefix-canary

deployment-bot: Scheduled flag-toggle job: fast-prefix-cache -> 10% at 2026-03-18T00:30:00 PDT by maria

maria: Starting 10% flip at :30. devon/sanjay please ack when you see the flag change and initial metric snapshot. If either of you sees a gate breach call rollback immediately.

devon: Ack — I see the flag at 10% and traffic shifting. Initial metrics aligning with staging.

sanjay: Cache hits up slightly, latency stable, no alerts yet.

maria: After 15m if stable, promote to 40%. Who will do that? Prefer someone not oncall to avoid interrupting night rotations.

elise: I can promote to 40% and will keep watching for the 30m window. Ill also temporarily lower the cache ttl on specific long-tail routes if we see minor p95 upticks.

devon: If anything breaches gates I will run: `./ops/flags/disable-fast-prefix.sh prod` and confirm rollback by posting the command output.

maria: Thanks. Post any anomalies here + tag ops. Ill write a short debrief thread after 100% complete with observed token savings and any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
